Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer failed to successfully extract the birthplace information from the Wikipedia page it opened. Although the text visible in the viewport clearly states "Samaras was born in La Trinité," the agent's subsequent analysis and instructions incorrectly claimed that the "infobox birth/origin information has not yet been extracted" and later erroneously concluded that the page listed the origin as "Paris, France" (a fact not present in the provided text). This failure to read the visible text correctly led to a delay and confusion in confirming the correct birthplace (La Trinité) instead of immediately utilizing the available evidence.
